comparison.objective: Tamp coffee level and bayonet-lock a portafilter; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting a loose portafilter, axial tamping, and bayonet insertion differ from holding a driver against jam-nut tightening reaction.
comparison.success_condition: Coffee tamped level and portafilter locked versus precise stop angle, nut retention, tool clearance, and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: No coupled screw-setting preservation or functional-cycle verification is tested.
